# The survey banner depends on the date and the server environment,
# so remove it from every capture.
{{$hideSurveyBanner := "document.querySelector('.js-surveyBanner')?.remove();"}}

test rl0
path /doc/go1
eval {{$hideSurveyBanner}}
capture fullscreen

{{range ints 1 22}}
  test rl{{.}}
  path /doc/go1.{{.}}
  # dd.indent is added by one of the last bits of JS to run on the page:
  # generateTOC in https://go.dev/js/godocs.js.
  wait dd.indent
  eval {{$hideSurveyBanner}}
  capture fullscreen
{{end}}
